methodology: The original research topic and the generated technical specification were decomposed into atomic information units based on individual requirements, features, behaviors, and constraints. Each unit is designed to be independent, self-contained, technically specific, unambiguous, and implementable as a single requirement. This ensures a granular comparison between the two sets of information.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Inputs: clk, w, R, E, L
Single stage of n-bit shift register
L not asserted, E asserted: shift, taking value from w
L and E not asserted: hold current value
data_out is the output to the next stage, which is the same as Q
spec_atomic_units: Module name: top_module
Inputs: clk, w, R, E, L
Output: Q
Implements one stage of a shift register
Combinational logic consists of a multiplexer
Multiplexer selects input to D flip-flop
L asserted: R is selected
L deasserted, E asserted: w is selected
L and E deasserted: Q is selected
Boolean expression: D = (L & R) | (~L & E & w) | (~L & ~E & Q)
Uses AND, OR, and NOT gates
Truth table for multiplexer selection provided
D is the output of the multiplexer (input to D flip-flop)
When L is high, the value of R is loaded
When L is low and E is high, the value of w is shifted
When both L and E are low, the flip-flop holds its current value
Sequential circuit (posedge)
Output Q changes on the positive edge of clk
Contains one register, Q, which is updated on the positive edge of the clock clk
Non-blocking assignment used to update Q based on w, R, E, and L
